preReview.title: Emery sees 'a lot of things to improve' for high-flying Aston Villa
preReview.description: Aston Villa have turned their season around with a "mature, responsible and ambitious" mindset, according to Unai Emery.

preReview.title: Emery: "Tante cose da migliorare" per l'Aston Villa lanciatissimo
